title: Hermite function for an indicator index
statement: For every natural number $n$, finite set $S\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and point $x\in\mathbb R^n$, the Hermite function indexed by the multi-index that is $1$ on $S$ and $0$ elsewhere equals $\prod_{i\in S}x_i$.
